messages.content: An audit checked 8 of 20 machines. All 8 checked machines passed. No results exist for the other 12. A report says: All 20 machines are healthy. Is that supported? Rewrite it accurately without losing the useful finding.

One technician must do A for 20 minutes, then B for 15 minutes; B requires A. Task C takes 10 minutes and is independent. Everything starts no earlier than 09:00 and the technician cannot overlap tasks. Give an earliest-finish schedule and explain whether any ordering can finish earlier.

A fictional system has two independent memory banks of 10 and 6 units. Reserve 2 units in each. Job X needs an indivisible 9-unit allocation. Job Y can split its 11 units across both banks. Which jobs fit alone while preserving reserves? Explain; do not assume pooling makes indivisible allocations splittable.
A queue contains jobs A, B, C, each one minute. B requires C, and A must finish before B. No other constraints apply. List every valid execution order, and no invalid orders.

Write a small Python function unique_recent(values) that retains the last occurrence of each string while preserving the order of those retained occurrences. For ['a','b','a','c','b'], return ['a','c','b']. Do not mutate the input. Include tests for empty input and repeated identical values.
